The '''Sky Cruiser''' was a type of [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]]-like [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] available during the [[Galactic War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Sky Cruiser first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' patch 2.5.2 released on January 14th, 2014 as one of the possible items players could receive from the Dogfighter's Starfighter Pack.<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://dulfy.net/2014/01/10/swtor-wingman-and-dogfighters-starfighter-pack-preview|text=SWTOR Wingman and Dogfighter's Starfighter Pack preview|author=Dulfy|date=2014-01-10|archivedate=20200410071737}}</ref>
